title: Deep kernel hedging
abstract: arXiv:2609.34474v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a deep kernel hedging framework that combines the flexibility of deep learning with the structural inductive bias of kernel methods. The hedging functional is restricted to a reproducing kernel Hilbert space whose kernel is parameterized through a neural network embedding of the input features. The framework minimizes a regularized empirical risk under convex loss functions and can accommodate path-dependent information through truncated time-augmented signature features. We derive a generalized representer theorem for the joint hedging problem, reducing the empirical optimization to a finite-dimensional problem. To further reduce the computational cost associated with large kernel matrices, we develop a scalable random Fourier feature approximation and establish convergence guarantees. translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种深度核对冲框架，该框架将深度学习的灵活性与核方法的结构归纳偏置相结合。对冲泛函被限制在一个再生核希尔伯特空间中，其核函数通过输入特征的神经网络嵌入进行参数化。该框架在凸损失函数下最小化正则化经验风险，并能够通过截断的时间增强签名特征来处理路径依赖信息。我们针对联合对冲问题推导了一个广义表示定理，将经验优化问题简化为有限维问题。为了进一步降低与大型核矩阵相关的计算成本，我们开发了一种可扩展的随机傅里叶特征近似方法，并建立了收敛性保证。随机傅里叶参数仅需采样一次并在整个训练过程中保持固定，而深度核则通过（此处摘要被截断）适应市场数据。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种深度核对冲框架，通过神经网络参数化核函数并结合广义表示定理与随机傅里叶特征近似，实现了可处理路径依赖信息的可扩展、高效金融对冲。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a deep kernel hedging framework that combines deep learning flexibility with kernel methods, achieving scalable and efficient hedging of path-dependent payoffs through a generalized representer theorem and a random Fourier feature approximation with convergence guarantees.
